content.en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, such as artificial neural networks and optimization algorithms, to accurately predict various outcomes in scientific studies. These algorithms have shown promising results in predicting things like the ultimate bearing capacity of foundations, the mean particle size in blasting, and the distance and velocity of flyrock induced by blasting. By combining different algorithms and models, scientists are able to improve the accuracy and reliability of their predictions in fields such as mining, drilling, and construction.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, såsom kunstige neurale netværk og optimeringsalgoritmer, for præcist at forudsige forskellige udfald i videnskabelige studier. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i at forudsige ting som den ultimative bærende kapacitet af fundamenter, den gennemsnitlige partikelstørrelse i sprængning og afstanden samt hastigheden af flyrock forårsaget af sprængning. Ved at kombinere forskellige algoritmer og modeller er forskere i stand til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og pålideligheden af deres forudsigelser inden for områder som minedrift, boring og byggeri.

critic.en: You’re telling me algorithms can predict "ultimate bearing capacity" and "mean particle size"? Oh boy, that's a game-changer. But you know what? I've got a few predictions of my own: as these algorithms become more entwined in critical processes, our dependence on them will create a myriad of new vulnerabilities, both in terms of security and social trust. Just wait for the day when we discover that the predictions were tampered with, or subtly skewed in favor of specific interests.
critic.da: Så vi skal altså basere vores samfundsstrukturer og sikkerhed på et miks af teknologier, der end ikke kan forklare selve mekanismerne bag deres prognoser.

potential.en: It's truly fascinating to see how predictive algorithms are being applied in scientific studies to improve the accuracy of predictions. By leveraging the power of artificial neural networks and other optimization algorithms, researchers are able to forecast a wide range of outcomes with impressive results. This not only helps in ensuring the safety and efficiency of various processes, but also opens up new possibilities for innovation and progress in the fields of mining, drilling, and construction.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan predictive algorithms bliver brugt til at forudsige komplekse resultater i videnskabelige undersøgelser. Denne teknologi kan revolutionere brancher som minedrift, boring og byggeri, da den gør det muligt at forudsige og planlægge med større nøjagtighed og sikkerhed. Kombinationen af forskellige algoritmer og modeller er afgørende for at forbedre præcisionen og pålideligheden af forudsigelserne. Jeg er sikker på, at denne udvikling vil have en positiv indvirkning på arbejdsmiljøet og reducere risiciene i de involverede aktiviteter.
